scope: AIT author-generated per-session test-score files, not training or ground-truth verification
metrics: recall at no more than 1% negative FPR, ties grouped
test_npz_collection_digest_method: SHA-256 of sorted sha256sum output for original server-side relative .test.npz filenames; containers in the release were regenerated without modifying arrays
note: The eight scenes also participated in method development. This score audit does not establish unseen-enterprise generalization or independent raw-to-model reproduction.
